question: An ability triggers when a permanent 'becomes tapped.' Does it trigger when a permanent enters the battlefield tapped?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it triggers only when a permanent already on the battlefield changes from untapped to tapped.
expected.answer: An ability that triggers when a permanent “becomes tapped” triggers only when the status of a permanent that’s already on the battlefield changes from untapped to tapped.
